snippet.title: Florana Defense Playtest Trailer (0.120.0 )
snippet.description:
This is the trailer I've created for the upcomint Steam Playtest of the Florana Defense on Steam.

Wishlist on https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840080/Florana_Defense/

Florana Devense is an upcoming incremental mazing tower defense, where you do not loose anything, just earn more gold and prestige.
